sources.title: Model Denial of Service (MoDoS) — Overloading AI with Adversarial Input
sources.snippet: Model Denial of Service (MoDoS) refers to attacks that deliberately overwhelm or degrade AI model performance by feeding it adversarial, malformed, or computationally expensive inputs. These attacks aim to exhaust processing power, generate large bills, or cause models to fail under load — creating new risks in the era of AI-driven systems.
